Replan after each returned label. Preserve the paired table and sampling log.

Record planning time, selection reasons, labels and unavailable attempts; unavailable attempts consume no allowance. Bound acceptance over remaining permitted label completions. Advance only if all meet gain >=4 and every slice loss <=2; reject only if none meet both; otherwise unresolved. Freeze decisions, affected-slice reports and accounting before opening the full-label key. Compare supported decisions and total resource use.
